response.justification: This candidate demonstrates exceptional technical depth with 20 years of software development experience and strong software craftsmanship principles (TDD, CI/CD). However, they have zero people management experience while the role explicitly requires a minimum of 2 years in a people-leadership capacity. As this is a full-time people-management position, the absence of any proven track record managing teams is a disqualifying gap. While their mentoring activities (workshops, code katas) show leadership potential and they have some experience with developer tools, these do not compensate for lacking formal management experience needed for this manager-level role.
strengths: Exceptional breadth of technical experience across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems with 20 years in the software development field
Strong software craftsmanship and engineering discipline demonstrated across all roles (TDD, CI/CD, code review, quality-focused practices)
Active mentor and knowledge sharer with evidence of leadership potential through organizing workshops, code katas, and refactoring dojos
concerns: Zero years of people management or formal team leadership experience, which is a minimum requirement for this manager role
Developer tools experience is scattered across personal projects and side responsibilities rather than 3 years of dedicated focused work
Current role is individual contributor (Staff Engineer) with no evidence of managing teams, setting priorities for others, or driving organizational change

key_factors.factor: 20 years of software development with strong technical depth
Developer tools experience is secondary to primary IC roles
